The goal is to survive as long as possible while collecting all the fallen gifts. Occasionally, eating a fruit will restore some of Santas energy, helping him to continue his journey. The faster you act, the more gifts you collect, but beware of the enemies attacks! Can you help Santa recover all the presents and save Christmas?
